## Context
Before this feature, the "Generating plan..." spinner was purely local component state in `PlanView.vue`. A browser refresh during an in-flight plan operation dropped the spinner, and if the still-running planner later emitted a `plan.questions` event, the QA dialog would pop up "cold" with no preceding generating context. This feature makes plan-operation state **server-truth**: the server tracks in-flight plan ops and a pending-questions signal, reports them in the socket `subscribe` snapshot, and the client restores the correct spinner/log/dialog on refresh. See the feature folder ([persist-generating-plan-across-refresh-mrm3c5r5](.jonggrang/.output/features/persist-generating-plan-across-refresh-mrm3c5r5/)) and [progress](.jonggrang/.output/features/persist-generating-plan-across-refresh-mrm3c5r5/progress.txt).

Delivered across 5 tasks: server registry ([task-001](.jonggrang/.output/features/persist-generating-plan-across-refresh-mrm3c5r5/jonggrang-tasks.json)), snapshot reporting ([task-002](.jonggrang/.output/features/persist-generating-plan-across-refresh-mrm3c5r5/jonggrang-tasks.json)), client spinner/log restore ([task-003](.jonggrang/.output/features/persist-generating-plan-across-refresh-mrm3c5r5/jonggrang-tasks.json)), dialog sequencing ([task-004](.jonggrang/.output/features/persist-generating-plan-across-refresh-mrm3c5r5/jonggrang-tasks.json)), and verification + headline fix ([task-005](.jonggrang/.output/features/persist-generating-plan-across-refresh-mrm3c5r5/jonggrang-tasks.json)).

## Facts
- **`activePlan` registry** (`apis/projects/index.js`): a `Map` keyed by project id → `{ child, command }`, declared alongside `activeWork`, exposed via `deps`, and iterated in the shutdown cleanup loop to SIGKILL tracked plan children (`entry.child`).
- **Command kinds** stored per spawn: `plan-revise` (revise), `plan` (generate/Pass A and answers/Pass B), `plan-extend` (extend) in `plan.js`; `approve` (approve & decompose) in `approve.js`. Registration pattern: `activePlan.set(project.id, { child, command })` then `child.on('close', () => activePlan.delete(project.id))`.
- **Snapshot `process` field precedence** (subscribe handler ~line 225): `activeWork` → `{command:'work'}`, else `activePlan.get(project_id)` → `{command: entry.command}`, else `null`. `work` still wins exactly as before — no work-mode regression.
- **Snapshot pending-questions fields**: `plan_questions_pending` (boolean, `false` not `null` when nothing pending) and `plan_questions_session_id`. Derived from the questions file on disk; wrapped in try/catch → `false` so a transient fs error never breaks the whole subscribe snapshot.
- **Client stores**: `process.js` gained `PLAN_COMMANDS=[plan,plan-revise,plan-extend,approve]` plus `planCommand`/`isPlanRunning` getters (no change to `setRunning`/`setExited` — snapshot `process={command}` and `process.started` both carry the same kind). `ws.js` `subscribed` handler forwards the full descriptor and sets an additive ws-store field `planQuestions = {projectId, pending, sessionId}` (guarded by `'plan_questions_pending' in snapshot`).
- **PlanView restore**: `restorePlanProcessState(info)` maps command→flag (`plan`/`plan-extend`→generating, `plan-revise`→revising, `approve`→approving), wired via `watch(() => proc.running, ..., {immediate:true})`. Spinner clears via the existing `process.exited` handler (~line 1006) which restored spinners reuse.
- **Questions sequencing**: refresh-only `questionsReady` ref renders a "Plan questions ready — answer them to continue generating" continuation in the progress-log region so the QA dialog reads as a follow-on, never cold. `applyPlanQuestions(goal_analysis, questions)` is shared by the live `plan.questions` socket handler and the new `restorePlanQuestions()`; wired via `watch(() => ws.planQuestions, restorePlanQuestions, {immediate:true})`. `restorePlanQuestions()` GETs `/plan/questions` (with `?session=` when known) only when the snapshot flags pending questions; try/catch keeps the user on the idle view on failure. `questionsReady` cleared in `submitAnswers` (Pass B takes over) and `cancelQuestions`. `!questionsReady.value` added to `isIdle` so the split layout/continuation renders for a plan.md-less pending-questions draft.
- **Spinner labels** verified: plan/plan-extend → "Generating plan...", plan-revise → "Revising plan with AI...", approve → "Decomposing plan into tasks...".
- **Files touched**: `apis/projects/index.js`, `apis/projects/plan.js`, `apis/projects/approve.js`, `client/src/stores/ws.js`, `client/src/stores/process.js`, `client/src/components/plan/PlanView.vue`, `test/project-drafts-api.test.js`.

## What Done & Why
- **[task-001](.jonggrang/.output/features/persist-generating-plan-across-refresh-mrm3c5r5/jonggrang-tasks.json) — activePlan registry.** Added the `activePlan` Map, exposed it via `deps`, added it to shutdown cleanup, and registered/deregistered the child at all five plan-family spawns (revise, generate/Pass A, answers/Pass B, extend, approve). Foundation for server-truth tracking of in-flight plan ops. Stored `{ child, command }` (not the bare child like `activeWork`) so the client can restore the correct spinner label; the shutdown loop therefore reads `entry.child`, diverging slightly from the activeWork loop shape.
- **[task-002](.jonggrang/.output/features/persist-generating-plan-across-refresh-mrm3c5r5/jonggrang-tasks.json) — snapshot reporting.** Replaced the `process` field with the precedence chain and added `plan_questions_pending`/`plan_questions_session_id`, so the client can distinguish "still generating" (spinner) from "questions ready" (dialog) and restore the correct spinner label. No client changes.
- **[task-003](.jonggrang/.output/features/persist-generating-plan-across-refresh-mrm3c5r5/jonggrang-tasks.json) — client spinner + log restore.** Threaded the command kind through `process.js`/`ws.js` into `PlanView`, restoring generating/revising/approving from server truth on mount and on later hydration. Used an immediate watcher (not a one-shot `onMounted` read) because subscribe→subscribed is async — the snapshot may land after mount. Log region reused the existing `v-if` template binding (no template edit).
- **[task-004](.jonggrang/.output/features/persist-generating-plan-across-refresh-mrm3c5r5/jonggrang-tasks.json) — dialog sequencing.** On refresh with a pending Pass A questions draft, the QA dialog no longer appears cold: a `questionsReady` continuation is shown first. Extracted `applyPlanQuestions()` shared by the live event and restore path; the live Pass A→questions flow (no refresh) is behaviorally unchanged.
- **[task-005](.jonggrang/.output/features/persist-generating-plan-across-refresh-mrm3c5r5/jonggrang-tasks.json) — verification + scenario-2 fix.** Full suite green (`npm test` 54/54 across all 8 suites; `npm run check:quick` 28/28 incl. Vite/Vue prod build). Traced all six refresh scenarios (server kind → snapshot → client flag → spinner label) — all map correctly. **Found & fixed the feature's headline defect (scenario 2):** the snapshot derived the pending-questions signal from `resolveActiveDraft()`, which is plan.md-gated (`getAllDrafts` skips any draft without plan.md). A mid Pass-A draft (plan-questions.json written, no plan.md) was invisible → `plan_questions_pending=false` exactly when questions were pending → the dialog never restored on refresh. Fix: resolve the pending signal via `lib.resolveActiveQuestionDraft(project.path) || sid` (the same resolver GET `/plan/questions` uses) and carry that session id in `plan_questions_session_id`; `plan_session_id`/plan content still use `resolveActiveDraft`. Added 2 regression tests.

## Lessons Learned
- **Mock-deps contract for router tests.** The plan/approve routers are unit-tested via `test/project-drafts-api.test.js` with a hand-built mock `deps` (its mock `spawnForProject` returns `{ on(){} }`). Any new dependency destructured in those routers MUST be added to that mock or the endpoints throw 500 — adding `activePlan.set()` broke plan/answers/approve until `activePlan: new Map()` was added to the mock.
- **`resolveActiveDraft()` vs `resolveActiveQuestionDraft()` asymmetry (recurring footgun).** `resolveActiveDraft()` (→ `getAllDrafts`) SKIPS any draft without plan.md. For anything that must see a mid Pass-A / questions-only draft, use `resolveActiveQuestionDraft()` (scans by questions-file mtime). GET `/plan/questions` already layered both resolvers; server snapshot code must match. `lib.questionsFileFor(project.path, sid)` is the canonical per-draft questions path helper.
- **The client process store is a GLOBAL singleton (no project key).** Any subscribe-time mutation must assume single-active-project. Task-003 deliberately did NOT add `else proc.setExited()` on an empty snapshot, since clearing could wipe another subscribed project's spinner; fresh refresh inits `running=null`, so clearing is unnecessary.
- **Immediate watcher for snapshot-derived UI restore.** Mirror the `watch(() => store.field, restoreFn, {immediate:true})` pattern (used for both `proc.running` and `ws.planQuestions`) to handle the snapshot-arrives-before-or-after-mount race — subscribe is async over the socket.
- **`isIdle` gates the entire split layout** (`plans.length===0 && !generating && !showNewPlanForm`). A pending-questions draft has no plan.md so `plans` is empty → any new right-panel/pre-plan state that must show pre-plan MUST be added to the `isIdle` exclusion list (as `!questionsReady.value` was) or it gets hidden. Same class of gotcha likely for future pre-plan UI states.
- **Watcher won't fight the exit handler.** The `plan.questions` handler sets `generating=false` while `proc.running` stays the same `{command:'plan'}` ref; the watcher fires only on ref change, so it won't resurrect the spinner.
- **Acceptable sub-second window.** A brief window exists where a plan process is running AND its questions file is present (between the agent's `plan ask` write and Pass A return, or Pass B start and its early clear at `bin/jonggrang.js:1616`). A refresh there could show the spinner AND the continuation together — still a visible generating context, so "never a bare dialog" holds. Not worth guarding.

## Open Questions / What Next
- Regression tests in `project-drafts-api.test.js` mirror the snapshot's resolution logic against `lib` resolvers rather than driving the real socket handler, because `socket.io-client` isn't installed and adding a dep was out of scope. If future work adds a socket integration test harness, replace the mirrored-logic tests with one that drives the real `subscribe`→`subscribed` round-trip.
- (Pre-existing infra note) `npm test` locally required installing `js-yaml`; the package.json/lock version bump was reverted to keep it out of the commit.

## Promotion Candidates
- Document the **mock-deps contract** for plan/approve router tests (`test/project-drafts-api.test.js`): every dep destructured in those routers must be mirrored in the mock.
- Document the **`resolveActiveDraft()` (plan.md-gated) vs `resolveActiveQuestionDraft()` (questions-mtime)** asymmetry — a recurring footgun for any code that must observe a mid Pass-A / questions-only draft.
- Document that the **client process store is a global singleton** (not keyed by project); subscribe-time mutations must assume a single active project and avoid project-agnostic clears.
